description: A live-events producer must approve the audience-participation format for a televised variety showcase, including the voting method, volunteer segment, headliner appearance, and production follow-up actions.

shared_context.S1: The televised variety showcase will be performed before a live audience on Saturday evening.
shared_context.S2: The current show draft includes an audience-voting segment, a volunteer performance, and a headliner appearance.
shared_context.S3: Morgan must approve the final format before the production schedule is released.
shared_context.S4: As part of the routine pre-release production meeting, Morgan asks the digital, labor, and artist teams to report any constraints that affect the final format.

PF1.text: Riley reviewed the voting platform's updated terms during this morning's setup and confirmed that the platform cannot collect audience phone numbers; voting must use anonymous QR tokens, and the audience-facing privacy notice must be updated. Riley has not added this to the show brief because the vendor posted the update after the brief was circulated.

PF2.text: Sam received the applicable union bulletin and confirmed that an audience volunteer segment requires exactly 8 paid volunteers and a scheduled group rehearsal before the live recording. Sam has not entered the requirement on the production board because the volunteer segment was still marked as provisional.

PF3.text: Taylor confirmed with the headliner's agent after the draft was circulated that the headliner cannot appear live during the showcase but has approved a prerecorded appearance to play at exactly 9:20 PM. Taylor has not revised the draft because the agent's confirmation arrived after the last creative review.

acceptance_conditions: Audience voting must use anonymous QR tokens.
Exactly 8 paid volunteers must be used in the volunteer segment.
The headliner appearance must be prerecorded.
The prerecorded headliner appearance must play at exactly 9:20 PM.
A privacy-notice update must be logged.
A volunteer rehearsal commitment must be logged.
A headliner-playback commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C1: 'anonymous QR tokens' in decisions['audience_vote_method'] or 'Anonymous QR tokens' in decisions['audience_vote_method']
content_checks.C5: 'privacy notice' in decisions['audience_vote_method'] or 'Privacy notice' in decisions['audience_vote_method'] or any('privacy notice' in c['detail'] or 'Privacy notice' in c['detail'] or 'privacy notice' in c['target'] or 'Privacy notice' in c['target'] or 'audience-facing privacy' in c['detail'] or 'audience-facing privacy' in c['target'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('group rehearsal' in c['detail'] and '8 paid volunteers' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('prerecorded' in c['detail'] and '9:20 PM' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The updated platform terms change the voting method from ordinary phone-based or unrestricted voting to anonymous QR tokens and require the privacy-notice update.
The union bulletin changes the volunteer plan to exactly 8 paid volunteers and adds the required group rehearsal commitment.
The agent confirmation changes the headliner from a live appearance to a prerecorded appearance scheduled exactly at 9:20 PM and requires a playback commitment.
